label: Active Power
description: AC active power at the PCS terminals; + discharging / - charging

label: Power Factor
description: Total power factor; sign follows Var

label: Throttle Source
description: What is limiting output right now

label: State of Charge
description: Usable state of charge as % of WHRtg

label: Control Mode
description: Remote commands are accepted only in REMOTE

label: DC Voltage
description: Battery bank DC voltage (SunSpec name V; renamed DCV here to avoid clashing with AC voltages)

label: DC Current
description: Battery bank DC current (SunSpec name A); + discharging

label: DC Power
description: Battery bank DC power (SunSpec name W); + discharging

label: Max Reserve SoC
description: Upper reserve (SunSpec spelling with lowercase oc)

label: Available Discharge Power
description: Max discharge power the BESS can deliver now (SoC/temperature/strings considered)

label: Available Charge Power
description: Max charge power the BESS can accept now (magnitude)

label: Auxiliary Power
description: HVAC and auxiliary load of the BESS enclosure; + consuming

label: Active Power Setpoint Mode
description: WSet in W or WSetPct in %

label: Active Power Setpoint %
description: Active power command as % of WMaxRtg

label: Connect Command
description: Connect or disconnect the battery bank (contactors)

label: Commanded Active Power
description: Setpoint after mode and static limits (what the PCS is trying to do)
